rapport_notes: Excellent — patient, thorough, encouraging, and handled a complex piano/storage/friend's-house logistics puzzle very well.

evidence_quotes.agenda: let's talk about your move Amanda. What are your biggest concerns for the upcoming move and what are the most important things you want answers on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: with regards to the piano what type of piano is this? / It's an upright. / for an upright piano we can only move it from ground floor to ground floor. Are you moving to now to another one story house?
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: the less time we take the less money you end up spending at the end of a day.

top_strength: Dug two full layers into the piano concern (type, floor-to-floor requirement, destination logistics) rather than taking a surface answer, and proactively coached the customer on saving money by self-prepping — a genuine Save-Your-Ass moment.
coaching_note: Never used the quid-pro-quo framing at the top of the call and never asked 'does that feel fair' before the close — small structural pieces to tighten given how strong the rest of the call was.
